fichas.title: Hospital Functional Areas and Departments
fichas.summary: Hospitals are organized into operational areas and departments: examination and treatment, care, administration, social services, supply and waste disposal, education and research, and other services. Examination and treatment is a major area; departments are preferably located in the basement, ground floor, or first floor, with outpatient attendance concentrated on the ground floor. Bringing medical disciplines together supports cooperation and consultation.

fichas.title: Partial Plan of Luckenwalde Hospital
fichas.summary: Partial plan of a 300-bed hospital by Thiede Messthaler Klosges. The plan organizes X-ray diagnosis and ambulance admissions/A & E alongside clinical and outpatient functions, internal and external corridors, support spaces, and connections to the main traffic corridor. Printed plan dimensions are transcribed with their unit left unstated because none is shown in the source.
